Remark
[Smoothness with a radius-$R$ sphere factor]

Source: petersen:page-0052 ↗ thm:pet-ch1-smoothness-criterion

1. ch1:1.6.8For $dr^2+\rho ^2(r)g_{S^{n-1}(R)}$ with $\rho (0)=0$, smoothness at the origin requires \[ \dot\rho (0)=1/R, \qquad \rho ^{(2k)}(0)=0\quad (k\ge 1). \]
